Genuine tension flagged: unlike reading-the-return.md (which opens on a bolded diagnostic QUESTION before its failure-mode list), this file's own maintainer note (line 21) confirms the positive-discipline half ('The moves': keep manual reps, calibrate your own miss rate, let the gates carry the vigilance) was deliberately CUT from the promoted lecture, so both slides are framed entirely around the paradox with no discipline named in-body. Defensible as designed ('arms a lens, does not hand the fixes,' line 23) because the discipline is M5's Ronacher's-three-pattern payoff, not this opener's job — but this is a closer call than sibling lecture-openers in the same arc and worth a maintainer look, not a silent PASS.
